spl: index=web status=500 | stats count by host
index=main | eval latency=round(duration/1000) | stats avg(latency) by service
index=infra | dedup userId | stats count by region
index=logs | rex field=_raw "user=(?<user>\w+)" | stats count by user
index=events action=login | timechart span=1h count by action
index=web | stats count, avg(bytes) as avg_bytes by host, status
index=app level=ERROR | eval msg=lower(message) | search msg="*timeout*" | stats count
index=orders | eval total=price*quantity | stats sum(total) as revenue by region
index=auth action IN (login, logout, denied) | timechart span=5m count by action
index=jobs | eval state=if(code=0, "ok", "fail") | stats count by state
index=trace duration>1000 | spath path=span.name | stats p95(duration) by span.name
index=cache | rename hits as cache_hits | eval ratio=cache_hits/total | table host, ratio
index=web | bin _time span=1h | stats dc(userId) as users by _time
